title: Shapes All Around Me 🔺 A Rhyme for Kids
description:
Circles, squares, triangles and more! Mia shares an original rhyme about the shapes hiding all around us, in under a minute.

Curio Kids Club: short, curious answers to kids' big questions. Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@CurioKidsClub

lines.text: Can you spot the shapes all around you?
Let's go on a shape hunt with a rhyme. Look closely!
A circle is round, like a ball, or a clock that ticks on the wall. A square has four sides just the same, like a window or a board game.
A circle is round, like a ball,
Or a clock that ticks on the wall.
A square has four sides the same,
Like a window or a board game.
Can you see a circle near you right now? Maybe a plate, a button, or a wheel!
A triangle has three pointy sides, like a tent where a teddy hides. A rectangle's long, like a door, or a rug lying flat on the floor.
A triangle has three pointy sides,
Like a tent where a teddy hides.
A rectangle's long, like a door,
Or a rug lying flat on the floor.
Let's count corners! A triangle has three, a square has four, and a circle has none at all.
A star has five points, so bright. I draw one to wish you good night. A heart is a shape that I share. I draw it to show that I care.
A star has five points, so bright,
I draw one to wish you good night.
A heart is a shape that I share,
I draw it to show that I care.
Point to a door near you. It's a tall rectangle!
Shapes at home and in the park, shapes in the light and the dark. Look all around, near and far. Shapes are wherever you are!
Shapes at home and in the park,
Shapes in the light and the dark.
Look all around, near and far,
Shapes are wherever you are!
Circles, squares, triangles, rectangles, stars and hearts. What a great shape hunt!
Now it's your turn. Draw your favourite shape!
Happy shape hunting! Follow Curio Kids Club for more wonders. And next time someone asks... can you spot the shapes all around you?
